resources.string: The watch is not sending data. Check that the watch is on, nearby, and that SeizureGuard is running on it.
OSD is not receiving data. Check that OpenSeizureDetector is open and running.
OSD is not accepting watch data. In OpenSeizureDetector, set the data source to Garmin.
OSD rejected the watch data. Restart OpenSeizureDetector and check its data source is Garmin.
The bridge could not start. Open SeizureGuard and allow the Nearby devices (Bluetooth) permission.
